servers.name: Filesystem MCP
servers.description: Local filesystem operations for reading, writing, inspecting, copying, moving, deleting, and discovering files and directories.

tools.name: Read File
tools.description: Read and return the contents of an existing file from a provided filesystem path. Use when the user wants to open, inspect, view, retrieve, or read file contents.
positive_examples: show me what is inside this file

tools.name: Write File
tools.description: Write supplied content to a file, creating the file if necessary or replacing its current contents.

tools.name: Append File
tools.description: Add new content to the end of an existing file without replacing its current contents.
positive_examples: append this line to the log
add this text to the end of notes.txt
keep the existing file and add this

tools.name: Copy File
tools.description: Duplicate an existing file from one filesystem location to another while preserving the original.
positive_examples: make another copy of this file

tools.name: Move File
tools.description: Move or rename an existing file from one filesystem location to another.
positive_examples: move this file to another folder

tools.name: Delete File
tools.description: Delete an existing file from the filesystem.
negative_examples: clear the contents of this file

tools.name: List Directory
tools.description: Return the files and subdirectories contained within a specified directory.

tools.name: Get File Metadata
tools.description: Retrieve metadata for a file including size, timestamps, extension, and path information.
negative_examples: read the contents of this file

servers.name: Document MCP
servers.description: Document-oriented operations for extracting, searching, summarizing, and inspecting structured and unstructured documents.

tools.name: Extract PDF Text
tools.description: Extract readable textual content from a PDF document while preserving basic page ordering.
positive_examples: give me all text in report.pdf
negative_examples: search this PDF for a topic

tools.name: Extract DOCX Text
tools.description: Extract paragraphs and textual content from a Microsoft Word DOCX document.
positive_examples: extract the text from this Word file

tools.name: Summarize Document
tools.description: Produce a concise summary of a supplied document while preserving its major arguments, findings, and conclusions.
positive_examples: give me a short overview of this report
what are the main points of this document

tools.name: Search Document
tools.description: Search within the contents of a document for passages relevant to a natural-language query.
positive_examples: find where this document discusses pricing

tools.name: Extract Document Section
tools.description: Retrieve a particular heading, section, chapter, or named portion of a document.

servers.name: Database MCP
servers.description: Structured relational database operations for querying, inspecting, inserting, updating, deleting, and aggregating data.

tools.name: Execute SQL Query
tools.description: Execute a read-only SQL query against a relational database and return matching rows.

tools.name: Inspect Database Schema
tools.description: Return information about database tables, columns, types, keys, and relationships.

tools.name: Insert Database Record
tools.description: Insert a new record into a database table.

tools.name: Update Database Record
tools.description: Modify existing records in a database based on supplied conditions.
positive_examples: change the status of these rows

tools.name: Delete Database Record
tools.description: Remove records from a database table that match supplied conditions.

tools.name: Aggregate Database Data
tools.description: Compute grouped database statistics such as counts, sums, averages, minima, and maxima.
negative_examples: calculate statistics on a local CSV

servers.name: Web MCP
servers.description: Synthetic web retrieval and extraction operations for pages, links, metadata, search results, and structured information.

tools.name: Fetch Web Page
tools.description: Retrieve the raw or rendered content of a web page from a supplied URL.
positive_examples: retrieve the page at this address

tools.name: Extract Web Text
tools.description: Extract the main readable textual content from a web page while removing layout and navigation noise.
positive_examples: give me the readable content from this webpage
remove menus and return page text

tools.name: Extract Web Links
tools.description: Extract hyperlinks and associated anchor text from a web page.
positive_examples: list all links on this page

tools.name: Extract Web Metadata
tools.description: Retrieve page metadata such as title, description, canonical URL, headers, and publication information.
positive_examples: what is the page title and description

tools.name: Extract Structured Web Data
tools.description: Extract specified structured fields such as product names, prices, dates, entities, or table rows from a webpage.
positive_examples: get these fields from the webpage

tools.name: Search Web
tools.description: Search an indexed synthetic web corpus using a natural-language query and return ranked web results.
positive_examples: search the web for MCP routing
look up pages discussing tool discovery

servers.name: Research MCP
servers.description: Academic and technical research operations for papers, metadata, citations, comparisons, and summaries.

tools.name: Search Research Papers
tools.description: Find research papers relevant to a scientific or technical natural-language query.

tools.name: Get Paper Metadata
tools.description: Retrieve metadata for a research paper including title, authors, year, venue, abstract, and identifier.
positive_examples: what year was this study published

tools.name: Get Paper Citations
tools.description: Retrieve research papers cited by or citing a selected paper.

tools.name: Summarize Research Paper
tools.description: Summarize the objective, methodology, experiments, results, and limitations of a research paper.
positive_examples: give me the methodology and results

tools.name: Compare Research Papers
tools.description: Compare multiple research papers based on methods, claims, datasets, experiments, results, or conclusions.

servers.name: Email MCP
servers.description: Synthetic email operations for sending, searching, reading, replying, drafting, and archiving messages.

tools.name: Send Email
tools.description: Send a new email message to one or more recipients with a subject and message body.
positive_examples: send an email to the team

tools.name: Search Email
tools.description: Search stored email messages using keywords, senders, subjects, dates, recipients, or natural-language criteria.
positive_examples: find the message about the meeting

tools.name: Read Email
tools.description: Retrieve the full body and metadata of a specific stored email message.

tools.name: Reply Email
tools.description: Send a reply within an existing email conversation.

tools.name: Create Email Draft
tools.description: Create and save an email draft without sending it.
positive_examples: save this as an email draft
prepare an email but don't send it

tools.name: Archive Email
tools.description: Remove an email from the active inbox while retaining the message in stored mail.
positive_examples: remove this message from inbox but keep it

servers.name: Calendar MCP
servers.description: Calendar and scheduling operations for creating, searching, updating, deleting, and checking event availability.

tools.name: Create Calendar Event
tools.description: Create a new calendar event for a specified date, time, duration, location, and optional attendees.
negative_examples: send an email invitation without creating an event

tools.name: Search Calendar Events
tools.description: Find existing calendar events matching a date range, title, participant, location, or query.
positive_examples: what meetings do I have Friday

tools.name: Update Calendar Event
tools.description: Modify an existing calendar event's title, time, attendees, location, or description.

tools.name: Delete Calendar Event
tools.description: Cancel or remove an existing calendar event.
positive_examples: remove this event from my calendar

tools.name: Check Calendar Availability
tools.description: Determine open and occupied time intervals within a requested date or time range.
positive_examples: find an open slot on Friday

servers.name: Messaging MCP
servers.description: Synthetic team messaging operations involving channels, messages, threads, workspace history, and search.

tools.name: Send Channel Message
tools.description: Send a new message to a specified team communication channel.
positive_examples: send a Slack message to general

tools.name: Search Messages
tools.description: Search historical team messages across channels and conversations.

tools.name: Reply to Thread
tools.description: Post a response within an existing threaded team conversation.

tools.name: List Channels
tools.description: Return available communication channels in the synthetic messaging workspace.

tools.name: Get Channel History
tools.description: Retrieve recent messages posted to a selected messaging channel.

servers.name: Git MCP
servers.description: Source-control operations for repositories, branches, commits, diffs, status, and history.

tools.name: Get Git Status
tools.description: Return the current working-tree and staging status of a Git repository.

tools.name: Get Git Diff
tools.description: Show line-level differences between repository states, commits, branches, or working files.

tools.name: Get Commit History
tools.description: Retrieve recent commits and associated metadata from a Git repository.

tools.name: List Git Branches
tools.description: List local and remote branches available in a Git repository.

tools.name: Create Git Branch
tools.description: Create a new Git branch from the specified revision or current repository state.

tools.name: Create Git Commit
tools.description: Create a new Git commit containing staged repository changes.
positive_examples: save staged changes with this message

servers.name: Issue Tracker MCP
servers.description: Software issue and project-tracking operations for searching, reading, creating, updating, and commenting on development tasks.

tools.name: Search Issues
tools.description: Search software issues using keywords, labels, states, repositories, or natural-language descriptions.

tools.name: Read Issue
tools.description: Retrieve the title, body, comments, labels, state, and metadata of a specific issue.

tools.name: Create Issue
tools.description: Create a new software issue with a title, description, and optional metadata.
positive_examples: file an issue for this problem

tools.name: Update Issue
tools.description: Modify an existing issue's state, title, description, labels, assignment, or other properties.

tools.name: Comment on Issue
tools.description: Add a new comment to an existing software issue or development task.
positive_examples: post this response to the bug

servers.name: Text MCP
servers.description: Natural-language transformation and analysis operations including summarization, translation, sentiment, extraction, rewriting, and classification.

tools.name: Summarize Text
tools.description: Condense supplied plain text while preserving its most important information.
positive_examples: give me the key points of this text
negative_examples: rewrite this in a nicer tone

tools.name: Translate Text
tools.description: Translate supplied text from one language into another while preserving meaning and intent.

tools.name: Analyze Sentiment
tools.description: Determine whether supplied text expresses positive, negative, neutral, or mixed sentiment.
positive_examples: analyze the sentiment of this message

tools.name: Extract Keywords
tools.description: Identify important keywords, phrases, and concepts appearing in supplied text.

tools.name: Extract Entities
tools.description: Extract named entities such as people, organizations, places, dates, products, or events from text.
positive_examples: find people and places mentioned here

tools.name: Rewrite Text
tools.description: Rewrite supplied text according to a requested tone, style, length, clarity, or audience.

tools.name: Classify Text
tools.description: Assign supplied text to one of a predefined set of semantic categories.
positive_examples: which category does this message belong to
label this text as billing or technical

servers.name: Math MCP
servers.description: Deterministic mathematical and numerical operations for arithmetic, statistics, percentages, finance, and equations.

tools.name: Calculate Expression
tools.description: Evaluate a mathematical arithmetic expression and return its numerical result.

tools.name: Calculate Descriptive Statistics
tools.description: Compute descriptive statistics such as mean, median, variance, standard deviation, minimum, and maximum for numeric values.

tools.name: Calculate Percentage Change
tools.description: Calculate the percentage increase or decrease between two numeric values.
positive_examples: how much did revenue decline in percent
negative_examples: calculate a percentage of a number

tools.name: Calculate Compound Interest
tools.description: Calculate future value from principal, interest rate, compounding frequency, and duration.
positive_examples: what will 1000 become at 8 percent for 5 years

tools.name: Solve Linear Equation
tools.description: Solve a linear equation or small system of linear equations for unknown variables.
positive_examples: find x in this linear equation

servers.name: Data Analysis MCP
servers.description: Operations for inspecting, filtering, sorting, grouping, transforming, and analyzing tabular datasets.

tools.name: Inspect Dataset
tools.description: Return dataset columns, types, dimensions, null counts, and representative sample values.
positive_examples: what columns are in this dataset

tools.name: Filter Dataset
tools.description: Select rows from a dataset according to supplied conditions or predicates.
positive_examples: show rows where revenue is over 1000

tools.name: Sort Dataset
tools.description: Sort dataset rows according to one or more columns and ordering rules.

tools.name: Group Dataset
tools.description: Group dataset rows according to categorical values and compute requested aggregations.

tools.name: Create Calculated Column
tools.description: Add a derived column to a dataset by applying a deterministic expression to existing fields.
positive_examples: create total price from quantity and unit price

tools.name: Analyze Missing Values
tools.description: Identify missing or null values and summarize their distribution across a tabular dataset.

servers.name: JSON MCP
servers.description: Structured JSON operations for parsing, querying, validation, transformation, and comparison.

tools.name: Parse JSON
tools.description: Parse serialized JSON input and return its structured representation or parsing errors.
positive_examples: convert this JSON text into an object

tools.name: Query JSON
tools.description: Retrieve values from nested JSON using a structured path or field-based request.

tools.name: Validate JSON Schema
tools.description: Validate JSON data against a supplied JSON Schema and report validation violations.
positive_examples: validate this JSON against this schema
does this payload match the schema

tools.name: Transform JSON
tools.description: Restructure JSON data by selecting, renaming, mapping, nesting, or removing fields.
positive_examples: map this payload into another schema

tools.name: Compare JSON
tools.description: Compare two JSON structures and report additions, removals, and changed values.

servers.name: System MCP
servers.description: Safe synthetic system-information operations for machine state, storage, memory, processes, and environment data.

tools.name: Get System Info
tools.description: Return operating system, architecture, hostname, processor, and runtime information.
positive_examples: what OS is this machine running

tools.name: Get Disk Usage
tools.description: Return total, used, and available disk storage for a specified filesystem location.
positive_examples: how much disk space is left
check free space on this drive

tools.name: Get Memory Usage
tools.description: Return total, used, and available system memory information.
positive_examples: how much RAM is being used

tools.name: List Processes
tools.description: Return currently running synthetic processes and basic process metadata.

tools.name: Read Environment Variable
tools.description: Return the value of an allowed synthetic environment variable.
positive_examples: what is the value of APP_ENV

servers.name: Geo MCP
servers.description: Geographic operations for locations, coordinates, distances, time zones, and country information.

tools.name: Geocode Location
tools.description: Convert a place name or postal address into latitude and longitude coordinates.
positive_examples: what are the coordinates of this place

tools.name: Reverse Geocode
tools.description: Convert latitude and longitude coordinates into a human-readable geographic location.
positive_examples: what place is at these coordinates
convert lat long to an address

tools.name: Calculate Geographic Distance
tools.description: Calculate approximate geographic distance between two coordinates or named locations.
positive_examples: how far apart are these coordinates

tools.name: Lookup Timezone
tools.description: Determine the timezone associated with a geographic location.
positive_examples: which timezone does this location use

tools.name: Lookup Country Information
tools.description: Retrieve basic synthetic geographic information about a country such as capital, region, and country code.
positive_examples: what is the capital of Japan

servers.name: Media MCP
servers.description: Synthetic image and media operations for metadata, dimensions, resizing, cropping, format conversion, and content description.

tools.name: Get Image Metadata
tools.description: Retrieve image format, dimensions, file size, and associated image metadata.
negative_examples: describe what is in the image

tools.name: Resize Image
tools.description: Resize an image to specified dimensions.

tools.name: Crop Image
tools.description: Extract a rectangular region from an existing image.
positive_examples: crop the top-left part of this image
cut this image to this rectangle
extract this region from the image

tools.name: Convert Image Format
tools.description: Convert an image between supported formats such as PNG, JPEG, and WebP.
positive_examples: save this image in another format

tools.name: Describe Image
tools.description: Produce a textual description of visible objects, layout, and content in an image.

servers.name: Utility MCP
servers.description: General deterministic utility operations involving dates, identifiers, hashing, encoding, and decoding.

tools.name: Calculate Date Difference
tools.description: Calculate the elapsed duration between two supplied calendar dates or timestamps.
positive_examples: how many days between these dates
how long from August 1 to August 20

tools.name: Add Date Duration
tools.description: Add a specified duration in days, weeks, months, or years to a calendar date.
positive_examples: what date is three weeks after August 1
move this date forward two months

tools.name: Generate UUID
tools.description: Generate a valid universally unique identifier.

tools.name: Hash Text
tools.description: Compute a deterministic cryptographic digest of supplied text using a specified hashing algorithm.
positive_examples: generate a hash of this string

tools.name: Base64 Encode
tools.description: Convert supplied text or bytes into Base64 representation.

tools.name: Base64 Decode
tools.description: Decode valid Base64 input back into its original text or byte representation.
positive_examples: convert this Base64 string back to text
what does this Base64 value contain
